layoutcorrector.title: Layout Corrector Settings
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.enabled: Enable or disable the layout corrector mod globally
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.correct_layo: Automatically converts keys typed in the wrong layout (e.g. .крсщы to /spawn)
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.add_remove_b: Creates or updates an alias. To delete, click the alias in the right-hand list.
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.clear_list: Deletes all custom aliases currently defined
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.reset: Reverts all configuration options to factory defaults
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.done: Saves your configuration and returns to the game
layoutcorrector.gui.tooltip.chat_prefix: The prefix that triggers layout correction in chat (default: '.'). Type the prefix followed by a command in the wrong layout.
